tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, high-performance web crawler and scraper designed to transform web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown.
tools.Use_Case: Automated data extraction for RAG pipelines, AI agents, and custom data analytics.

tools.Name: vLLM
tools.Description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient engine for serving large language models, featuring PagedAttention and support for numerous model architectures.
tools.Use_Case: Production-grade serving of LLMs with high throughput and low latency for diverse infrastructure.

tools.Name: Agent Governance Toolkit
tools.Description: A toolkit for enforcing policies, managing identities, and monitoring autonomous AI agents to ensure safety and reliability in production.
tools.Use_Case: Implementing guardrails and compliance checks for AI agents to prevent unauthorized actions and tool abuse.
